validity_findings.finding: All freeze bindings verified independently: freeze.json hashes match request.json, spec.json, prereg.md, design_review.json and the three carrier files (src/spider/kernel.py 3a6caf97..., models.py 338aaf4d..., registry.py 51fb440d...). The frozen runner embedded in prereg.md section 12 is byte-identical (36234 bytes) to raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_calibrated_v3.py and hashes to ec480f38c3c5c2f2bfff282aea3ef75654b0c6d2f4453dbca6d0321f03002229 == CANONICAL-RUNNER-V3-SHA256. All four artifact hashes in result.json/provenance.json match. The parent v2 runner pin (60855 bytes, sha d4871091dc5bf9aa21d918f2577612aa8c5762e314033d0bbbee46b4962bc608) is enforced fail-closed in-runner (V0) and verified present. No frozen file was modified post-freeze (git history: design c1c698b2 -> execute base f659c6f5; provenance.git.frozen_files_unmodified=true).

The frozen classifier (cost_verdict_v3/aggregate_v3, hash-bound) was applied as preregistered. Independent recomputation from the 36 raw trials reproduces, for every class P1-ENDPOINT/P2-STRUCTURE/P3-PERMISSION: functional_ok=true (repair 1.0, Wilson lower 0.7575 >= 0.60, contamination 0.0 <= 0.10, write_set_max 1, guard 1.0), eq=true (M-PRODUCT-RATIO-REUSE-L2 0.9444 < 1, L3 0.8947 < 1, M-COST-FETCH-RATIO-L3 0.667/0.556 <= 0.90), cw=true (M-CALIBRATED-WIN), lw=false (M-LATENCY-R-L2 and R-L3 both > 1.00) -> SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED on all three classes -> aggregate MIXED-PARTIAL -> outcome MIXED, status COMPLETE, invalid_reasons=[]. No misapplication of the decision rule found.

The H2 calibrated-win surface has weak independent discriminating power on this substrate and must not be over-read. The Stage-A 'repair' op times only Arm.charge_repair_attempt() - a TrajectoryCounters increment plus note/sync, median 2.11e-7s (weight 0.000582) - not the actual repair-path work (local_repair patch construction, registry upsert, guard/signal scaffolding). DESIGN already knew this: the pre-freeze mini-calibration (N=60, raw_evidence/preflight_liveness.json, weights [1.0, 0.117143, 0.104703, 0.000544]) sat three orders of magnitude below the precomputed critical repair weights (M-WEIGHT-CRITICAL-REPAIR-WEIGHT-L2=2.0, L3=3.0) at which the calibrated surface could flip. Given the mean op-count vectors (reuse saves 2-3 fetches, costs +1 near-free repair), the calibrated counter could essentially never show a reuse loss on this substrate; M-CALIBRATED-WIN=true and the 81-combo band 1.0 were near-guaranteed once V-CALIB passed. This was disclosed (design_review NB-3; result.json validity_notes calling the counter 'an incomplete end-to-end model'; repair explicitly labeled 'repair-bookkeeping'), was preregistered before outcomes, and both surfaces were reported - so this is NOT MEASUREMENT_INVALID and NOT a frozen-rule violation. But the producer's reading 'the parent's counter-dependence does NOT reproduce on this surface' is justified only as: under a fetch-numeraire re-weighting in which repair bookkeeping is ~free, reuse wins. The genuinely new, decision-relevant information in this packet is the latency surface (H3), not H2.

The two preregistered surfaces genuinely diverge and the producer correctly treats the divergence as the finding rather than collapsing it. Calibrated counted-op model: reuse strictly cheaper at L=2 and L=3 on all classes (M-CALIBRATED-RATIO-REUSE-L2 0.7803/0.6819/0.7803, L3 0.7031/0.6144/0.7031; M-CALIBRATED-ROBUST-BOTH=1.0). End-to-end episode latency: reuse strictly slower at both budgets on all classes (M-LATENCY-R-L2 1.2118/1.1407/1.2513; R-L3 1.0976/1.0459/1.1451), with reuse slower than cold-L3 in 36/36 and slower than cold-L2 in 36/36 individual trials (independently counted from raw trials). The mechanism of the latency excess is unidentified (episode scaffolding - guard Jaccard, fused-probe signal work, registry construction, deepcopies, server dispatch - is uncounted by calibration); producer records this in unresolved and does not invent a decomposition. The mandate asked for an end-to-end counter; no single measured object on this substrate is one, and the packet says so.

Bootstrap CIs (B_LAT=2000, fixed seeds, percentile on the median ratio) were recomputed exactly and match result.json to 1e-9. Every CI95 excludes 1.0 from above as claimed, but the P2-STRUCTURE L3 interval lower bound is 1.002171497916499 - it clears 1.0 by ~0.2%. With n=12 paired trials and a percentile bootstrap this single interval is not individually decisive; the direction is nevertheless strongly supported by the per-trial sign pattern (reuse slower in 12/12 trials per class against both cold budgets) and by the L2 intervals, which clear 1.0 by 8-22%. Downstream should carry the P2-L3 CI margin rather than cite 'every CI excludes 1.0' as if all intervals were wide.

M-MODEL-CALLS-TOTAL=0 and M-MODEL-TOKENS-TOTAL=0 are measured from kernel counters but are structurally zero: no LLM/model endpoint exists on this credential-free substrate (V2-SUBSTRATE_ISOLATION; B3 NOT SATISFIED carried as unknown). The mandate's 'model calls/tokens' component of the end-to-end product-economics counter is therefore absent, and byte volume (median 78 B/fetch) is diagnostic only with no byte<->time rate. Any claim beyond this substrate about real agent product economics is out of ceiling; producer bounded this correctly in validity_notes and report.md.

Frozen spec.product_consequence_negative names the EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED tier for permanent drop, but its parenthetical gloss - 'equal-weight strict win reproduces but calibrated_win is false and/or latency_win is false' - also literally covers the OBSERVED pattern (eq=true, cw=true, lw=false = SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED), whereas the frozen decision rule defines EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED strictly as eq with BOTH cw and lw false. The observed class verdict SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED is therefore not unambiguously inside or outside the frozen permanent-drop clause. The producer applied the conservative reading (no permanent drop; 'adjudication matter for DIRECTOR'; promote_to_product=false; no re-admission) and did not overclaim in either direction. This is a frozen-text ambiguity, not a producer error; DIRECTOR must resolve it explicitly in verdict.json rather than citing either clause as self-executing.

Design-review NB-1 (spec prose lists V13-LEGACY_REPRODUCTION as auto-invalidation while the hash-bound runner and prereg treat it as a reported caveat; the runner's invalid list indeed omits it): moot for this run - V13 satisfied under both readings (M-PRODUCT-RATIO-LEGACY-L2=1.1111111111111112 > 1.00 all classes, M-LEGACY-REGRESSION-REPRODUCED=true) - but the latent spec/runner inconsistency persists for future packets. NB-2 (carrier-hash enforcement at EXECUTE pre-flight, not in-runner): enforced - all three carrier hashes independently re-verified equal to freeze.json.artifact_hashes in this audit. NB-3 (DESIGN mini-calibration showed fetch-dominant weights favoring reuse): confirmed; absorbed into AF-3 - the DESIGN probe was not scored and no bar was fit to it, but it means H2's outcome direction was knowable pre-freeze.

All controls verified from raw evidence: PC-BASE-LIVENESS 36/36 true trials; B-COLD/B-COLD-MIN success 1.0 with products 19/18 (exact per-trial constant); B-LITERAL-REPLAY 0.0 and B-NO-REPAIR 0.0 on all classes (perturbation bites, abstention inert, never a denominator); NC-NO-PERTURBATION and NC-NOISE both stale=false; NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR fired 4/4 unaffected resources in every trial (in-support probe id 14, corrected F1 instrument live); V-TIMING 72/72 warmups, exact 6/6 rep-first parity per class, 0 timed errors, all latencies finite>0; V14 oplogs present every trial and legacy oplog differs from reuse exactly by the rebind+resolve repair and full-batch re-execution semantics (e.g. P1: reuse 17 ops with repair_attempt, legacy 19 ops with rebind+resolve; verified on raw trials). Leakage checks: write_set exactly 1 (only the perturbed target mechanism changed) on all 36 trials; contamination 0/144 in-support probes on genuinely unaffected resources; treatment uses pre-perturbation learned mechanisms plus cached structural tokens (the inheritance under test, not leakage); cold arms never receive the cache; calibration weights come from an independent unperturbed workload (Stage-A, own LocalApp, before any trial) and never from arm outcomes (V10). No baseline substitution: B-COLD is the sole cost/latency denominator; conservative/legacy arms are reported sensitivities correctly excluded from the classifier.

M-OVERBROAD-CONTAMINATION-RATE / M-OVERBROAD-CONTAMINATION-RATE-MEAN = 4.0 is a per-trial COUNT of broken unaffected resources (0-4), not a 0-1 rate; the sensitivity gate (rate > CONTAMINATION_BAR=0.10) is satisfied in substance (4/4 every trial) and the misnomer is disclosed in result.json controls.NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR.note. No arithmetic impact; naming invites downstream misreading and is preserved under the producer's identifier here rather than renamed.

The latency surface is measured on an in-process ThreadingHTTPServer over 127.0.0.1 with ~4ms median episodes and absolute reuse-cold gaps of ~0.2-0.9ms. Timing integrity is sound (1ns timer, RSEs <= 0.012, 6/6 order parity, 2 excluded warmups per trial, fixed bootstrap seeds), and the reuse-slower sign is unanimous per-trial, so this is not noise. But it is a single-vantage localhost measurement whose excess is unattributed (see AF-4); no transfer to real web, browser/network economics, production carriers or external agent harnesses is licensed. Producer's scope bounds in validity_notes/report.md are correct and complete on this point.

report.md interpretation matches result.json and raw evidence at every checked number (ratios, medians, CIs, weights, control verdicts, decision MIXED-PARTIAL); observations contain observations, not interpretations; no measurement exists only in report.md; the report does not exceed the frozen claim (no re-admission requested, no promotion, permanent drop explicitly deferred). result.json metrics are the raw runner metrics plus six additive M-RUNNER-* mirror fields; every shared metric key is byte-identical to raw_evidence/runner_result_raw.json (verified by full dict comparison).

claim_ceiling: MEASUREMENT-VALID, BOUNDED MIXED: on the credential-free localhost stdlib substrate with the shipped hash-pinned carrier, three LOCAL perturbation classes (P1-ENDPOINT/P2-STRUCTURE/P3-PERMISSION), n=12/class, and the frozen classifier, reuse-based localized repair is functionally/locality-sound (H1: success 1.0, Wilson 0.7575, contamination 0/144, write-set 1) and reproduces the parent equal-weight strict win (0.9444 L2 / 0.8947 L3) plus the parent counter-dependence (grid 0.78/0.67, critical repair weights 2.0/3.0); under the preregistered fetch-numeraire time-calibrated counted-op counter (weights [1.0, 0.116023, 0.104291, 0.000582] where the repair dimension is counter-bookkeeping only, ~0.21us - a near-free dimension whose win direction was knowable at DESIGN, AF-3) reuse is strictly cheaper at L=2 and L=3 (band 1.0), BUT under measured end-to-end episode latency reuse is strictly SLOWER at L=2 and L=3 on every class (R 1.05-1.25, all CI95 above 1.0, 36/36 per-trial signs; P2-L3 margin ~0.2%, AF-5). Decision SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED x3 = MIXED-PARTIAL = outcome MIXED is the correct frozen-rule result. Maximum justified claim: the equal-weight counter-dependence is NOT resolvable as a pure equal-weight artifact - one product-adjacent measured surface (time-calibrated op economics) favors reuse, the only true end-to-end surface measured (wall-clock episode latency) decisively disfavors it, and no constructed counter on this substrate is complete end-to-end (model calls/tokens structurally absent per B3, scaffolding uncounted, AF-6). Localized repair is NOT re-admitted to C-PRODUCT-ECON by this evidence; permanent drop is NOT self-executing from the frozen text for SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED (AF-7) and remains a DIRECTOR adjudication. Not a falsification of the repair mechanism; no promotion; no claim transfers to real web, production carriers, external agents, or model-call economics.
